name: note inc.
summary: note inc. is in the media platform and IP content creation business in Japan. Its note service lets creators publish digital content, sell it and talk with their audience, note pro is a SaaS for corporate information dissemination, and note money offers financial and investment articles. It also runs corporate-sponsored contests. Formerly Piece of Cake, Inc., it was renamed in April 2020, incorporated in 2011 and has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
